articles.title: Europe targeted by spiralling campaign of sabotage and Russia is the chief suspect - BBC
articles.description: Germany has blamed Russia for an attack on Leipzig airport but there has been a series of suspicious incidents elsewhere.
articles.content: "There are many, many signals that Russia is changing its strategy and intensifying its activities, including terrorist and sabotage activities," Marcin Kierwiski said, warning people to be on their … [+5 chars]
